title: The Zealot's Revenge
text: Have Lita Chantler’s [reaction] ability deal the killing blow to the Ghoul Priest.

title: I Don't Trust Her
text: When given the option to add Lita Chantler to your deck, refuse to do so.

title: Insurance Doesn’t Cover Ghouls
text: Burn your house to the ground in “The Gathering.”

title: …But Do I Have To?
text: In “The Midnight Masks,” have each investigator remain in Your House for the first three rounds.

title: Conspiracy of Silence
text: Find and interrogate all six unique cultists in “The Midnight Masks.”

title: Tour of Arkham
text: Trigger each of the “once per game” abilities on all of the locations in play in “The Midnight Masks.”

title: Do You Get It Now?
text: Trigger the Forced ability on Billy Cooper by defeating the Ghoul Priest at his location.

title: Pinch Hitter
text: Defeat three [[Ghoul]] enemies with a Baseball Bat without it breaking.

title: Even Death May Die
text: Defeat Umôrdhoth while the Vault of Earthly Demise is attached to it.

title: Break the Circle
text: Complete “The Devourer Below” without Umôrdhoth spawning.

title: They’re Just Misunderstood
text: Win the Night of the Zealot campaign without defeating a single unique [[Cultist]] enemy.

title: Umôrdhoth’s Favor
text: Win the Night of the Zealot campaign without defeating a single [[Ghoul]] enemy.

title: Line in the Sand
text: Win the Night of the Zealot campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

title: Arkham Expertise
text: Win the Night of the Zealot campaign on Expert difficulty.

title: What Is This Stuff, Anyway?
text: Defeat The Experiment using the Alchemical Concoction in “Extracurricular Activities”.

title: No Void For You
text: Complete “The Miskatonic Museum” without ever defeating the Hunting Horror.

title: First Rule of Arkham
text: Burn The Necronomicon in “The Miskatonic Museum.”

title: All Aboard
text: Complete “The Essex County Express” without letting any Helpless Passengers leave play.

title: The Gang’s All Here
text: In “The Survivors,” the following characters survived The Dunwich Legacy:
list_items: Dr. Henry Armitage | Dr. Francis Morgan | Professor Warren Rice | Zebulon Whateley | Earl Sawyer

title: No Brood Left Behind
text: Have no Broods of Yog-Sothoth escape into the wild in “Undimensioned and Unseen.”

title: Remind Me Not To Piss Her Off
text: Defeat either version of Seth Bishop while Naomi O’Bannion is under your control.

title: Eureka!
text: Identify the Strange Solution.

title: Beyond What Veil?
text: Take 10 damage from Beyond the Veil without being defeated.

title: Here We Go Again
text: Have Dr. Henry Armitage, Dr. Francis Morgan, and Professor Warren Rice in play at the same time.

title: Bird Hunting
text: Defeat 3 Whippoorwills in a single turn.

title: They Aren’t Getting Away With This
text: Win The Dunwich Legacy campaign as “Ashcan” Pete with Duke listed under “Sacrificed to Yog-Sothoth.”

title: Tabula Rasa
text: Win The Dunwich Legacy campaign with no [tablet] or [elder_thing] tokens in the chaos bag.

title: Line in the Sand
text: Win The Dunwich Legacy campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

title: Dunwich Expertise
text: Win The Dunwich Legacy campaign on Expert difficulty.

title: Fair Warning
text: Defeat the Royal Emissary three times during a single playthrough of “Curtain Call.”

title: First Steps
text: Interview the following VIPs in “The Last King”:
list_items: Constance Dumaine | Jordan Perry | Ishimaru Haruko | Sebastien Moreau | Ashleigh Clarke

title: Crashing the Party
text: Defeat the [[Lunatic]] version of Dianne Devine in “The Last King.”

title: For Prying Eyes
text: Add the Hidden Library to the victory display in “Echoes of the Past.”

title: The Cuckoo's Nest
text: Resign with Daniel Chesterfield under an investigator’s control in “The Unspeakable Oath.”

title: Take A Look At This!
text: Parley with the Host of Insanity in “The Unspeakable Oath.”

title: The Path of Death
text: Use your Clasp of Black Onyx to find a shortcut in “The Pallid Mask.”

title: Guessing Game
text: Advance to the final agenda of one agenda deck before advacing the first agenda of the other agenda deck in “Black Stars Rise.”

title: Hastur Made Me Do It
text: Defeat Hastur in “Dim Carcosa” while a Possession treachery is in your hand.

title: Say My Name
text: After you have heeded Daniel’s warning, speak the name of HASTUR aloud seven or more times during a single scenario (or its setup).

title: Get Back Here
text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign having never ended a scenario with The Man in the Pallid Mask in play

title: The Path is False
text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign with 8 Doubt.

title: The Path is Real
text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign with 8 Conviction.

title: The Path is Mine
text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign with less than 2 Doubt and Conviction in total.

title: Line in the Sand
text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign with at least three Ultimatums active.

title: Carcosa Expertise
text: Win The Path to Carcosa campaign on Expert difficulty.

title: Why Did It Have to Be Snakes?
text: Defeat twenty [[Serpent]] enemies.

title: Watch Them Unravel
text: Complete all four act decks during a single playthrough of “Threads of Fate.”

title: Hope for Humanity
text: Restore Ichtaca’s faith in humanity in “The Boundary Beyond.”

title: Scenario 5-What?
text: Skip “Heart of the Elders, Part 1.”

title: Beyond Perfection:
text: Complete all eight tasks on act 2 of “The City of Archives” during a single playthrough.

title: I Remember Everything
text: Restore Alejandro’s memories in “The City of Archives.”

title: Patricide
text: Defeat Yig in “The Depths of Yoth.”

title: He's Got a Point
text: Side with Alejandro in “Shattered Aeons.”

title: Valusia Sounds Great
text: Side with Ichtaca in “Shattered Aeons.”

title: I’ve Built Up An Immunity
text: Win The Forgotten Age campaign without ever becoming poisoned.

title: We Have an Understanding
text: Win The Forgotten Age campaign without ever dealing any damage to the Harbinger of Valusia.

title: Who Needs Any of This Junk?
text: Win The Forgotten Age campaign without purchasing any supplies.

title: Don’t Tread on Me
text: Win The Forgotten Age campaign with no tally marks recorded under Yig’s Fury in your Campaign Log

title: Bane of Yig
text: Win The Forgotten Age campaign with 25+ tally marks recorded under Yig’s Fury in your Campaign Log.

title: If I Could Turn Back Time
text: Forge your own path, unlock Scenario IX, and win The Forgotten Age campaign.

title: Yoth Expertise
text: Win The Forgotten Age campaign on Expert difficulty

title: Who You Gonna Call?
text: Defeat 13 [[Geist]] or [[Spectral]] enemies. Enemies who are not discarded or added to the victory display do not count.

title: Savior of Humanity
text: Rescue every [[Silver Twilight]] enemy who appears in "At Death's Doorstep."

title: 10/10 Would Read Again
text: Using the Black Book, take a total of 10 horror with its ability throughout the campaign.

title: Carl Shmarl
text: Become part of the Silver Twilight Lodge's Inner Circle, then betray them in "Union and Disillusion."

title: The Threefold Rule
text: Join forces with Erynn and turn on her coven in "Union and Disillusion."

title: New World Order
text: Help the Silver Twilight Lodge win The Circle Undone campaign.

title: Immortality Sounds Nice
text: Help Anette's Coven win The Circle Undone campaign.

title: More Like Excursion
text: Complete "In the Clutches of Chaos" without a single incursion occurring.

title: 'Member These?
text: Discover the following Mementos:
list_items: Mesmerizing Flute | Ritual Components | Scrap of Torn Shadow | Strange Incantation | Gilman's Journal | Keziah's Formulae | Worn Crucifix | Wisp of Spectral Mist | Corn Husk Doll | Bloody Tree Carvings

title: Case Closed
text: Save each of the following characters from a terrible fate:
list_items: Valentino Rivas | Gavriella Mizrah | Penny White | Jerome Davids

title: Music of the Outer Gods
text: Accept your fate and win The Circle Undone campaign by joining the Pipers of Azathoth.

title: Weaver of Shadow and Mist
text: Reject your fate and win The Circle Undone campaign by crafting a spell to contain Azathoth.

title: Fine Print
text: Win The Circle Undone campaign by signing your name in The Black Book of Azathoth.

title: duolA sdroW eht kaepS
text: Win The Circle Undone campaign by discovering and reversing an ancient incantation.

title: Circle Expertise
text: Win The Circle Undone campaign on Expert difficulty.
